correctness.rationale: Global energy foliation uses positivity inside the square and properness at even double edges. Exact quadrant duration follows from dF/dt=-xy; the parameter-boundary truncated defect integral is elementary. At sigma*p=-1 the inverse edge distance is asymptotic to (2E)^-1, giving (log E)/2+log 2. At most two critical defects have convolution O(log E/E), so adding four quadrants gives m log E and the exact constants. With 1-p=kappa/E, endpoint scaling E*delta->kappa/(exp(2kappa)-1), including the continuous kappa=0 extension, yields the displayed crossover uniformly on compact kappa ranges. Checker algebra and finite diagnostics executed from extracted package, not treated as proof.

value.rationale: The originating quartic square has a natural geometric loss of simple edge multiplicity at |p|=1 or |q|=1. This induces a genuine new logarithmic time delay not present in the earlier finite-offset regime: m=0,1,2 and a sharp 1/E parameter crossover with nonconstant Psi.
